stem:
Priya connects a cell, a switch and a lamp in series using wires. The switch is open and the lamp does not light.
Her teacher asks her to draw a circuit diagram of what she has built.
Which diagram correctly represents Priya's circuit?

options.text: A cell, a closed switch and a lamp joined in a single loop, with standard symbols
A cell, an open switch and a lamp joined in a single loop, with standard symbols
A cell and a lamp joined in a single loop, with no switch shown
A cell and two lamps joined in a single loop, with an open switch

teacher.key_rationale: The circuit diagram must faithfully translate the actual circuit: one cell, one open switch and one lamp in series. Only B matches all components and the open state of the switch; A wrongly closes the switch, C omits it, and D adds a second lamp.
